Text-only procedure

Water pump replacement procedure

  1. Isolate the electrical supply and close the upstream valve.
  2. Remove the WP-450 coupling guard and drain the casing.
  3. Install replacement reference AF-P-1042 and align the motor shaft.
  4. Prime the centrifugal pump before restarting the system.
